# fct_terms_conditions_forms

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_terms_conditions_forms` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for how users interact with the Terms and Conditions forms that advisors create and send to their clients for a signature. Each row is a unique T&C form created (forms are created from a T&C template). Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `form_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each Terms & Conditions form created. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each Advisor who created the Terms and Conditions form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `agreement_form_template_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each Terms & Conditions agreement template. Forms are created from stored templates. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | Timestamp when the Terms & Conditions form has been archived by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID for the client each Terms & Conditions form is assigned to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the Terms & Condition form was created by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_form_created_to_signed` | Number of days between the Terms & Conditions form's created_at and signed_at date. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions form has been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `was_customized` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions form was created from a customized template or Fora's quick start template. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_signed` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions form was signed by the assigned client. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_template_active` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions form's template is active. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `minutes_form_created_to_signed` | Number of mins between the Terms & Conditions form's created_at and signed_at timestamps. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `signed_at` | Timestamp when the Terms & Condition form was first signed by the assigned client. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `short_id` | Foreign Key. Shorten form ID displyed in the URL for each Terms and Conditions form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `status` | Indicates whether current status of the Terms & Conditions form is signed, pending, archived, or outdated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp of when the form was last updated by the Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `version` | Indicates the version of the Terms & Conditions feature is in use. >> SOURCE - Portal |
